Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. rationale: Frame stores locals and code; Configuration separates objects and counter from an optional frame. running combines a State with code; initial starts running State.empty even for an empty statement list; state projects live locals or an empty store. These match the tuple, run equation and initialization. Local state/code observations are explicitly distinguished from the public machine; finishedness is now defined separately.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Proof correctness is checked separately by Lean; the correspondence review compares statements, definitions and example propositions.
Abstract syntax and mathematical GC are modeled; no parser or executable collector is certified. Functions safety permits divergence.
